description: This Java source file defines the 'FeaturesModified' event class, which is emitted after a 'Features' object associated with an IoT 'Thing' has been modified. It includes methods for constructing the event, deserializing from JSON, and providing access to the modified features, along with various overrides for JSON serialization and equality.

classes.name: FeaturesModified
classes.description: Immutable event class representing a modification to a Thing's Features, with methods for creation, JSON serialization/deserialization, and equality checks.

methods.description: Constructs a new FeaturesModified event with specified parameters, including optional timestamp and metadata.

methods.description: Creates a FeaturesModified instance from a JSON string or JSON object, given appropriate headers.
